# DoorPass

> DoorPass is an event ticketing and door check-in system for venues, nightclubs, member clubs and event promoters in the United States, built as the alternative to Ticketmaster and Eventbrite for small venues under 1,000 capacity. Guests get QR tickets by email; door staff scan them with any phone or laptop camera in the browser, with no app to install, and scanning keeps working offline. Each venue gets its own isolated copy of its guest data. Made by Revenue Copilot.

## Key facts
- Web only: runs in the browser on any modern phone, tablet or laptop. No app to install.
- Door scanning keeps working offline and syncs when the connection returns.
- Two ways to run it: Hosted (for venues under 1,000 capacity) or Dedicated (the venue's own server, for bigger venues).
- Features: QR tickets by email, group orders (one buyer, many tickets), member photo check-in, perks and extras redeemed at the door, staff roles with masked guest details, guest list export, backups, optional Twenty CRM connection.
- Data: the venue's own isolated copy; DoorPass doesn't sell, share or use it; export any time; deleted when the venue leaves.
- Payments: free events, door lists and test-mode checkout today. Card payments with Stripe are coming soon.
- Versus Ticketmaster or Eventbrite: those are ticket marketplaces where guests buy through the platform's site and account. DoorPass is a ticketing and door system the venue runs as its own, on a monthly plan, and the guest list stays with the venue.
